svg.title: Proposed (Aim 2): from scientific intent to evidence through MARS and Skynet 2
svg.desc: A proposed workflow in four lanes: user, MARS, Skynet 2 and facility. A user states a scientific objective. MARS, using the capabilities registered in Skynet 2, turns it into measurement requirements and an observing-and-analysis plan, which the user reviews and approves; only then does MARS send an observation request through a constrained interface. Skynet 2 performs access control and capability matching, scheduling and dispatch through the SkyNode gateway to SkyNode at each telescope, under local operator control, and returns data and quality assessment. MARS analyses the data with its existing tools and checks scientific adequacy separately from operational success; the user receives the result with its evidence, or the limiting requirement and a follow-up for review. Dashed outlines are to be built under Aim 2; solid outlines exist: MARS today, and Skynet 2, funded by NSF ATI, which keeps facility selection, scheduling and execution.
